articles.description: Byla vydána nová verze 2.54.0 distribuovaného systému správy verzí Git. Přispělo 137 vývojářů, z toho 66 nových. Přehled novinek v příspěvku na blogu GitHubu a v poznámkách k vydání.
articles.title: Git 2.54.0

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Grafana (Wikipedie), tj. open source nástroj pro vizualizaci různých metrik a s ní související dotazování, upozorňování a lepší porozumění, byla vydána ve verzi 13.0. Přehled novinek v aktualizované dokumentaci a na YouTube. Stalo se tak na konferenci GrafanaCON 2026.
articles.title: Grafana 13.0

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Na YouTube proběhl Framework [ Next Gen ] Event 2026. Společnost Framework představila nový Framework Laptop 13 Pro, vylepšení Framework Laptopu 16 a OCuLink Dev Kit pro připojení vysoce výkonných periferií jako jsou eGPU a bezdrátovou klávesnici s integrovaným touchpadem Framework Wireless Touchpad Keyboard.
articles.title: Framework [ Next Gen ] Event 2026

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byl vydán Mozilla Firefox 150.0. Přehled novinek v poznámkách k vydání a poznámkách k vydání pro vývojáře. Řešeny jsou rovněž bezpečnostní chyby. Nový Firefox 150 bude brzy k dispozici také na Flathubu a Snapcraftu.
articles.title: Firefox 150.0

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byl představen (reddit, 𝕏) webový prohlížeč Brave Origin. Jedná se webový prohlížeč Brave bez VPN, krypto peněženky a odměn, tj. bez funkcí, ze kterých je vývoj Brave financován. Stojí jednorázově 59,99 dolarů. Verze pro Linux je zdarma.
articles.title: Webový prohlížeč Brave Origin

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Tim Cook po 15 letech opustí post generálního ředitele americké technologické společnosti Apple. Od 1. září ho vystřídá John Ternus, který byl dosud odpovědný za hardware. Cook se stane předsedou představenstva. Cook vedl Apple od roku 2011, kdy funkci převzal od zesnulého spoluzakladatele společnosti Stevea Jobse.
articles.title: Tim Cook po 15 letech opustí post generálního ředitele společnosti Apple

articles.author: MakeIranBombedAgain❗
articles.description: Evropská aplikace na ověřování věku uživatelů lze hacknout během dvou minut, navzdory tvrzením předsedkyně Evropské komise Uršuly von der Leyenové, že je tato aplikace 'technicky připravená pro ostré nasazení' a 'splňuje nejvyšší standardy ochrany osobních údajů na světě'. Zdrojové kódy aplikace byly Bruselem zveřejněny v repozitářích na GitHubu.
articles.title: Evropská aplikace na ověřování věku je děravá jak řešeto

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Po 26 letech od protiprávního policejního zásahu, který byl spuštěn na základě podnětu společnosti Microsoft, Obvodní soud pro Prahu 2 rozsudkem potvrdil, že Mironet prokázal významnou část svého nároku na náhradu škody vůči Ministerstvu spravedlnosti ČR. Soudem nyní přiznaná část nároku znamená rekordní odškodné, jaké kdy české soudy přiznaly za nesprávný postup státu. Spor byl rozdělen na několik škod, u pravomocně uzavřených částí sporu byl Mironet v nárocích úspěšný. Ministerstvo spravedlnosti svými opakujícími se návrhy podle Mironetu zbylou část sporu neúměrně prodlužuje, ale i prodražuje. S přihlédnutím k zákonným úrokům z prodlení a nákladům mnohaletého řízení se celková výše odškodnění vyšplhala na 1,5 miliardy Kč [Kurzy.cz].
articles.title: Český stát zřejmě bude Mironetu platit rekordní odškodné za protiprávní policejní zásah

articles.author: |🇵🇸
articles.description: Lehké desktopové prostředí LXQt bylo vydáno ve verzi 2.4.0. Jde o převážně opravné vydání s drobnými vylepšeními podpory Waylandu.
articles.title: LXQt 2.4.0

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Počítačová hra Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 českého studia Warhorse získala cenu BAFTA v kategorii nejlepší příběh. V konkurenci pěti dalších nominovaných děl porazila i úspěšnou francouzskou hru Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, která v letošním ročníku získala cenu za nejlepší hru roku.
articles.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 získala cenu BAFTA v kategorii nejlepší příběh

The Division 2's server maintenance on April 23 is now over, but if you're hit with a login queue, you're not alone. Players trying to gain access to the servers immediately after the maintenance have been put into the queue, where they need to wait for a chance.


This guide will briefly explain why you might be seeing their queue and how you can avoid it.


The Division 2 login queue explained


The login queue in The Division 2 is in place to ensure that the server load remains smooth. When the game has been down for a few hours, chances are that many players might try to log in at the same time. The game is available on both PC and consoles, which also raises the number of players who try to start their session.


Screenshot by Destructoid


The login queue ensures that players enter the servers systematically, which also reduces the chances of an outage. This queue applies to players on both PC and consoles. However, the queue deactivates automatically when the logins have subsided. I have never experienced the queue when there hasn't been any maintenance involved.


If you want to play immediately post-maintenance, there's no way to avoid the queue. You should also refrain from quitting the game, as it will put you on a fresh virtual line of players. The only option is to wait for your turn patiently until you can start the game and access your save.


If waiting in the queue irritates you for some reason, the ideal solution is to simply wait. Once an hour or two has passed, the queue should disappear on its own. You should be able to log in directly without any extra seconds or minutes of waiting.

The post Why is there a login queue in The Division 2 appeared first on Destructoid.
articles.title: Why is there a login queue in The Division 2

Masters of Albion puts you in charge of a town that has fallen from its previous glories, but the magic was never lost. The same magic is now back, and it's affecting everyone. You're the one who will use its power and protect the interests of your citizens.

Fate of the Prophets is one of the more advanced side quests you can complete in Windrose. The recommended player level is 14, so you'll have a fair grind ahead of you to gain access to the quest.


Let's look at how to solve all the tasks of this quest in Windrose.


Windrose Fate of the Prophets quest walkthrough


The crux of the quest is about exploring the ancient observatories.



Stargazer Tower (First Stargazer)


Ancient Observatory


Warlord's death site



Travel to the Stargazer Tower (position will have a marker) and reach its inner sanctum. You'll have to solve the puzzle to open the secret room. Head inside and interact with the Observatory Stele to find out what happened to the first Stargazer.


Image via Kraken Express


The second one is in an ancient observatory that's located southeast of the Stargazer Tower. Follow the marker, and clear all enemies you can find in the area. Solve the puzzle and reach the inner sanctum. Interact with the second Observatory Stele to find out what happened to the second Stargazer.


Follow the marker and head north to find another observatory. The basic ritual is the same: kill the enemies, head to the inner sanctum, and interact with the Observatory Stele to find out what happened to the third Stargazer.


Image via Kraken Express


Finally, travel to the warlord's death site, but there won't be anything to note. Instead, you'll need to defeat Chick Chan. It's not the hardest of bosses, but it has a massive health pool. Hence, you'll inevitably take damage from its attacks. Just stock some healing items, and you should be good to go. Once Chick Chan is defeated, it will end Fate of the Prophets, and you'll get the following rewards.



10 Tumbaga Ingot

articles.description:
Paramount’s attempt to contain the leaked 'Avatar: Aang, The Last Airbender' has transformed into a digital game of whack-a-mole. Despite sending numerous takedown notices, the film is now firmly embedded in the piracy landscape, highlighting the limitations of traditional anti-piracy measures once a high-profile leak comes out.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Paramount Faces DMCA Whack-a-Mole as Leaked Avatar: Aang Movie Thrives on Pirate Sites

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Justices at India's Delhi High Court disagree on the future of India's world-leading site-blocking regime. The same court that pioneered "Dynamic+" injunctions to target pirate sites, issued a new ruling that sees these post-judgment expansions as fundamentally incompatible with the law. According to Justice Gedela, there is an "urgent and alarming" need for Parliament to intervene.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: India’s Expanding Site Blocking Orders Hit Legal Wall at Delhi High Court

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Every week we take a close look at the most pirated movies on torrent sites. What are pirates downloading? 'Project Hail Mary' tops the chart, followed by 'The Legend of Aang: The Last Airbender.' 'Avatar: Fire and Ash' completes the top three.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Top 10 Most Pirated Movies of The Week – 04/20/2026

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
GitHub has published its 2025 transparency report, revealing record levels of DMCA takedown activity across two separate metrics. The total number of removed projects increased to 47,228, while the number of circumvention claims jumped by more than 40% to 645. GitHub also highlights the U.S. Supreme Court's ruling in Cox v. Sony, which gives platforms more room to side with developers over rightsholders. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: GitHub Reports DMCA Takedown Record and Surging Anti-Circumvention Claims

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The Spanish-speaking manga community was in disarray last month when TuMangaOnline, also known as ZonaTMO, suddenly disappeared. When the site's main domain was put on clienthold by its registrar, it was clear that legal pressure was mounting. Today, Korean copyright enforcement organization COA and the global anti-piracy firm IP House have confirmed their role in the takedown, revealing that Spanish police took action against the site's operators.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Korean Rights Holders Behind Takedown of Manga Piracy Giant TuMangaOnline

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Hollywood giant Warner Bros. Entertainment is concerned about the "alarming" growth of IPTV piracy in Chile. After securing a dynamic site blocking order in February, targeting brands like MagisTV and FlujoTV, the studio is now raising the stakes with a criminal complaint targeting Streaming Chile SpA, an operation that claims to serve over 35,000 customers worldwide.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Warner Bros. Files Criminal Complaint Against Chilean IPTV Operator Over “Alarming” Piracy Growth

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Spotify and several major record labels, including UMG, Sony, and Warner, secured a $322 million default judgment against the unknown operators of Anna's Archive. The shadow library failed to appear in court and briefly released millions of tracks that were scraped from Spotify via BitTorrent. In addition to the monetary penalty, a permanent injunction required domain registrars and other parties to suspend the site's domain names. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Anna’s Archive Loses $322 Million Spotify Piracy Case Without a Fight

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A new EU policy report published by the independent think tank CEPS points out that site-blocking efforts in several EU countries are seriously flawed. The report, which is funded by NordVPN's parent company, issues various recommendations, including a complete ban of IP-address blocking, which is prone to overblocking.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: EU Pirate Site-Blocking Is Broken: Report Calls for IP Blocking Ban and Rightsholder Liability

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
In a series of simultaneous rulings, the Paris Judicial Court ordered ISPs, VPN providers, and DNS resolvers to block access to 35 sports piracy sites. The orders were requested by Spanish football league LaLiga, which lacked standing as a foreign entity under French law. LaLiga licensee beIN Sports France had to intervene in the cases and secure the blocks in its own name.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Paris Court Issued Simultaneous Site Blocking Orders Against ISPs, DNS Resolvers and VPNs

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Six years after international police units searched houses and server farms across Europe, the alleged mastermind had his day in court. Amir Z., known to colleagues as "Dash the Iranian," faced 22.5 years in prison alongside four co-defendants. However, after they all pleaded guilty, the ringleader was sentenced to just over two years.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: RapidIPTV Kingpin ‘Dash the Iranian’ Gets Two Years Prison Under Spanish Plea Deal

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
HBO has obtained a DMCA subpoena, ordering X Corp. to identify the person behind a Euphoria fan account that allegedly posted spoilers from unaired episodes of Season 3. The action comes just days before the show's long-awaited premiere this weekend, but it remains unclear what the company plans to do with the requested information.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: HBO Obtains DMCA Subpoena to Unmask ‘Euphoria’ Spoiler Account on X

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Legal streaming service Kocowa hopes to have dealt the final blow to the Dramacool piracy network. The company obtained a default judgment in a U.S. federal court, which granted the transfer of 16 domain names, including dramacool.bg and dramacool.ba, which remain online. While the court noted that domain transfers are not a common measure under copyright law, it deemed it appropriate in this case.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Kocowa Secures Win Against Dramacool Pirates, U.S. Court Grants Domain Takeovers

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Following on the heels of the landmark Cox v. Sony ruling, the Supreme Court has vacated the contributory copyright infringement verdict against ISP Grande Communications, ordering the Fifth Circuit to reconsider its decision in light of the new precedent. The order is the latest setback for the record labels, whose campaign to hold ISPs liable for their subscribers' piracy continues to unravel.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Supreme Court Wipes Piracy Liability Verdict Against Grande Communications

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Major music publishers and the NMPA are asking a Texas federal court to throw out X's antitrust lawsuit, calling it a baseless attempt at retaliation. The music companies argue that X’s conspiracy theory rests on a single word in an email, while adding that their massive DMCA takedown campaign was not a sham but fully protected by the First Amendment.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Music Publishers Ask Court to Dismiss X’s ‘Weaponized DMCA’ Antitrust Suit

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Last week's Supreme Court decision in Cox Communications reshaped the piracy liability landscape, creating new urgency for site-blocking legislation in Congress. This could be addressed by Senator Thom Tillis and Representative Zoe Lofgren, who have been working on bicameral legislation that would require ISPs and DNS resolvers to block foreign pirate sites under court order, TorrentFreak has learned.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: U.S. Lawmakers Work on Unified Site-Blocking Bill to Counter Online Piracy

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The Supreme Court’s recent reversal of the billion-dollar Cox Communications verdict also makes an appearance in the long-running legal battle between Yout.com and the RIAA. The streamripper's counsel argues that  the ruling's treatment of noninfringing uses is relevant to its case against the RIAA. The music group disagrees, suggesting that it is not relevant.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Yout.com Hopes Supreme Court’s Cox Ruling Helps Its Case; RIAA Disagrees

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Elon Musk’s X is moving for a total dismissal of the high-profile copyright lawsuit filed by major music publishers, claiming that the Supreme Court just pulled the rug out from under the labels’ case. Citing the recent Cox v. Sony decision, the social media platform argues that the "contributory infringement" theory used to keep the litigation alive is now legally defunct.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: X Asks Court to Dismiss Music Piracy Lawsuit After Supreme Court’s Cox Ruling

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The Paris Court of Appeal has confirmed that third-party DNS providers can be legally compelled to block access to domain names to stop piracy. The DNS providers countered that such measures are technically burdensome and easily bypassed. However, the court ruled that the intermediaries must act nonetheless and pick up the bill themselves. This is a clear win for Canal+, which pioneered the blocking expansion.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Google, Cloudflare, Cisco Lose Pirate Site DNS Blocking Appeal in France

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A new breed of hypervisor-based bypasses can 'crack' Denuvo-protected games on the day of release, marking a fundamental shift in the piracy landscape. Denuvo parent company Irdeto informs TorrentFreak that it is working on a countermeasure while warning that the new cracks are a security concern. Popular repacker FitGirl initially flagged security concerns as well, but embraced the new cracks as they improved.  
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Game Pirates Beat Denuvo with Hypervisor Bypasses — Irdeto Promises Countermeasure

articles.description: Je nutno docenit význam tohoto filmu pro světovou kinematografii a jeho revolučnost v době svého vzniku. Je dobře, že si Tarantino dovolil tohle natočit. Ale jako více než čtyřhodinový film je fyzické obtížné to vydržet (i s přestávkou) a neusnout. Bonusová závěrečná desetiminutovka nestojí za nic. (Ilča 60 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Kill Bill: Kompletní krvavá aféra [Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair] - 70 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Rozhlasová hra / audiokniha, která sama o sobě není příliš dobrá (střídavě nesmyslná a extrémně předvídatelná), ale laciný obrazový doprovod ji činí ještě horší. Chvílemi to celé má blízko k sofistikované parodii, ale jen chvílemi. (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Říkají mi Lars - 30 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Je pro mě neuvěřitelné, že to režírovali stejní lidé, protože je to natočeno mnohem hůř než jednička. To, co se mi v ní líbilo, tzn. zajímavě vykreslené postavy, originální vizuální nápady, atmosféra... To všechno je ve dvojce podstatně horší. A navíc samozřejmě chybí ten punc originality, kterým se mohla pyšnit jednička. (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Krvavá nevěsta: Hra začíná [Ready or not 2: Here I come] - 40 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Velmi kvalitní pocta Hitchcockovi, která nepůsobí jako sebestředná onanie a má i nějakou emocionální hloubku. (Ilča 90 %)
articles.title: Retro recenze: Neznámá [La Sconosciuta] - 90 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Řemeslně OK (hlavně soundtrack, hojně citující z videoher), ale scenáristicky hrozné a ještě prázdnější než jednička. A čí nápad to byl, použít v důležité roli postavu, jejíž poslední videohra vyšla před deseti lety (takže ji cílová skupina tohoto filmu vůbec nezná)? (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Super Mario galaktický film [The Super Mario Galaxy Movie] - 30 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Tenhle film je pro mě jakýmsi vykrystalizováním špatných českých komedií do jejich nejryzejší podoby. Úplně všechno v tomto filmu vypadá a zní jako kdyby to vygenerovala umělá inteligence. Ale kdyby to vygenerovala umělá inteligence, bylo by to pravděpodobně zábavnější, protože bych se pak dočkal nějakých velkolepých akčních scén a digitálního Oldřicha Nového. (Ilča 20 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Někdo to rád v Plzni - 10 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Zajímavý, stylově konzistentní počin s unikátní atmosférou předchozích Omerzuových filmů, ale se dvěma výtkami: 1) Herecké výkony nejsou tak univerzálně kvalitní jako dřív. 2) Podstatná část filmu (cca poslední třetina) je skoro hardcore psychologický thriller, ke kterému "absurdní nedějovost a nelogičnost zápletky" moc nesedí. (Ilča 40 %)
